Commands:
  help - display help menu
  info - display system info
  channel - get/set current channel
  settings - display or change settings
  scanall - scan APs and Stations
  scanap - scan for APs
  scansta - scan for Stations
  sniffbeacon - sniff beacon frames
  sniffdeauth - sniff deauth frames
  sniffpmkid - sniff PMKID handshakes
  sniffraw - raw 802.11 sniffer to SD
  sniffbt - sniff BLE devices
  stopscan - stop any active scan or sniff
  attack - execute authorized attack test
  reboot - reboot the device
  clearlist - clear discovered targets
